title: Modernize SSO and token stacks: SAML XML canonicalization, OpenSSL 3.1, and strict JWT verifier migration
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Background: Our SSO surface has accumulated multiple compatibility shims and legacy XML canonicalization code that are fragile and block FIPS/KMS workflows. We also have multiple services using older OpenSSL 1.1.x ABI and different JWT libraries (node-jsonwebtoken, older java-jwt forks) leading to signature verification inconsistencies and transitive CVE exposure. Scope: 1) Replace ad-hoc XML canonicalization in the SAML verifier with a canonical, well-tested implementation and remove fragile regex-based patches. 2) Upgrade OpenSSL system packages and runtime bindings to 3.1.x across auth services (auth-proxy, saml-verifier, token-service) and validate ABI compatibility. 3) Migrate token handling in node and java services to strict verifier libraries (golang-jwt/v4 or jose where applicable) and enforce strict alg and kid checks. Goals: reduce CVE exposure, eliminate flakey SAML edge-case failures, enable FIPS-compatible build paths, and standardize token verification behavior across languages. Non-goals: rewriting SSO logic or changing IdP contracts. Expected customer impact: immediate reduction in intermittent SSO failures for enterprise customers and removal of known high-severity crypto dependencies.
tasks: Audit all services that import XML canonicalization or use custom SAML parsing (auth-proxy, saml-verifier, dashboard-auth, legacy-ssosvc)
Choose and vendor a canonical XML-DSig/C14N library (java: xmlsec 3.x + patches; node: xml-crypto replacement) and add deterministic tests
Upgrade OpenSSL native packages to 3.1.2 in base images and verify native binding tests for each language runtime
Replace node-jsonwebtoken usages with jose (or node-jwt) and enable strict alg/kid checks; add regression tests for HS/RSA/PS signatures
Migrate Java services to Nimbus JOSE+JWT 9.x or equivalent and remove unsafe parsing helpers
Add integration test harness with a local IdP emulator covering signed assertions, encrypted assertions, and replay scenarios
Run canary deployment of updated saml-verifier to 10% of auth traffic with rollback gates and increased logging
Coordinate with infra on package builds (musl vs glibc) and FIPS-enabled OpenSSL image variants
Perform a targeted dependency vulnerability scan and remediate any new findings before full rollout
Document upgrade and rollback procedures in Confluence and notify SRE/Support teams
